title: Tests of take_turn really sleep SAME_CHAT_GAP (1.5 s) on Instant::now()
fix: Take a Clock trait/manual clock argument so the test asserts the computed wait without sleeping

title: BoostBoxState::note is cleared by hand beside phase
trigger: note is set by toggle_slot and the error arm, and cleared in toggle_slot, request_chat_boost (two sites), reassign_boosts and the BoostChat answer; cancel_boost_reassign, close paths and apply_decision leave it.
effect: A 'wait until the boost is available' or error line can stay on the counters after cancelling the reassign list (cancel_boost_reassign resets phase to Main but not note).
fix: Put the line inside the phase (Main { note: Option<String> }, Reassign { .. note }) so every transition replaces it

title: ShareLink::Fetching carries no RequestId; answers and failures are matched by the speaker bool
trigger: Click Share Invite Link, revoke the invite link (share_links reset to Default) while a getVideoChatInviteLink is still in flight
effect: The late answer lands via answered(speaker, link) on an Idle slot and shows the revoked link as Got
fix: ShareLink::Fetching(RequestId) and compare it in answered/failed

title: 'No speaker link' is Got(String::new()) written by plan() from can_manage/rtmp, never revisited
trigger: Open Share Invite Link as a member (speaker settled to Got("")), then get promoted to admin in the same call and open it again
effect: plan() sees ready() and sends nothing; the speaker checkbox stays missing until the links are reset by a revoke or the call ends. The empty string also stands for 'none', 'failed' and 'answered empty'
fix: Speaker link as its own enum: Unavailable / Idle / Fetching(RequestId) / Got(link), recomputed from can_manage

title: 'Send without compression' is not stored: three readers infer it from attachment kinds with three different rules
trigger: Any tray mixing Document and Photo/Video kinds
effect: append_dropped_files uses any(Document with a media extension); composer_ui/mod.rs:650 uses can_send_as_files && all(Document); send_box_options.rs:79 composer_media_options uses all(Document) (true for an empty tray or a tray of plain files, which clears hd_photos). The mode is a derived guess that also changes when keep_as_file or the GIF rules change a kind
fix: One enum SendMode {Compressed, AsFiles} on the tray (ComposerSends slot), set by the checkbox and by pick_attachments(as_files)

title: AccountProgress (and Progress) carry per-stage fields beside the stage enum
trigger: export moves ChatsList -> Chats -> next chat
effect: found is meaningful only in ChatsList; chat_index/chat_count/chat_name/chat only in Chats; Progress.total stays from the previous chat while the next one is Collecting, done means read-count in Collecting and saved-count in Writing

title: Unban and Add-special Remove report success when the request is queued, not answered
trigger: unban_member / kick_from_add_special: driver returns Ok(Some(id)) then TDLib refuses
effect: 'Member unbanned' / 'Member banned' note (and the picker closes) before the answer; a refusal only lands later in the member dialog's action error; the request id is dropped so nothing matches the answer to the note
fix: Hold Submit::Sent(id) for the action and settle through settle_moderation_submits like restrict/ban

title: Failed or unloaded invite-link counts are read as zero, so the 'apply to existing invite links' question is skipped
trigger: Change 'Approve new members' in the Type box and Save while fetch_chat_invite_link_counts failed, was refused, or has not answered
effect: chat_active_invite_link_count returns 0 for every non-Loaded state, so request_changed && links > 0 is false and the setting is saved without asking whether to apply it to existing invite links
fix: Save waits for (or retries) the counts: treat Failed/Idle as unknown, not as 0

title: LinkCheck names a debounce timer by version while the Task is detached; versions restart per box
trigger: Type in the link field (version 1, timer pending), cancel the Type box, reopen it within CHECK_DELAY_MS and type once (version 1 again)
effect: The first box's detached timer passes the version test for the new box and sends the server check early, bypassing the pause (wasted request, flicker). Idle and Typed also behave the same, so the enum is only a counter plus a Refused flag
fix: Hold the timer Task in LinkCheck::Typed { timer } (dropped on the next keystroke, box close or owner change) and drop the version counter

title: DeleteStep is a two-variant Idle/Asked confirm that survives other actions; the delete itself has no stage
trigger: Open a shortcut with messages, press Delete (label turns into 'Delete with all messages'), then add or edit a message and press the same button.
effect: ShortcutPane::delete stays Asked until quick_replies_go replaces the pane, so any later press deletes the shortcut; the delete request is fire-and-forget and the dialog goes to the list whether or not TDLib refuses.
fix: One pane stage enum (Editing/ConfirmDelete/Deleting{request}) cleared by every other action

title: Story open stage is an Option in ChatListUi beside the viewer, cleared by hand in six places
trigger: open_story writes chat_list.pending_story_open; resolve_pending_story_open clears it in four arms, story_changed (nav.rs:120) and release_story_viewer (mod.rs:724) clear it too.
effect: No bug today. The stage Closed / Waiting(open) / Open(viewer) is two fields (ChatListUi::pending_story_open and StoryUi::viewer) kept in step by hand, and the pending open lives in the chat list instead of StoryUi.
fix: A StoryOpen enum in StoryUi: Closed, Waiting(PendingStoryOpen), Open(StoryViewer); a close, step or replace is one transition
